critical.name: SHL IDC convention mismatch
critical.description: Excel uses full-source elapsed compound (TUHO 3,568.688). Runtime consumes Project.shl_idc_keur as manual (TUHO 1,169). Wiring the engine produces a different number than the current waterfall. Which is authoritative?

critical.name: Opening balance double-counting
critical.description: If the runtime consumes both the manual senior_opening_balance_keur (or shl_opening_balance_keur) AND the construction-engine output, the operating waterfall will pay interest on interest. Single most dangerous failure mode.

critical.name: Double-counting hidden in waterfall
critical.description: The operating waterfall reads Project.shl_opening_balance_keur and Project.shl_idc_keur. If the construction engine is wired AND also writes to those fields, the audit trail will not show whether values came from construction or project factory unless recorded explicitly.

high.name: Senior IDC effective rate brittleness
high.description: Senior IDC target calibrated to effective rate. Excel base rates and day-count not yet modeled. Any change to construction period (e.g. COD shift) invalidates the effective rate.

high.name: Project status drift
high.description: Wiring construction into waterfall risks silently moving TUHO and Oborovo from Level 2 (Reference) to Level 3 (Runtime-Authoritative Construction) without explicit promotion gate.

high.name: Manual override policy
high.description: Runtime currently trusts manual project factory inputs. If construction engine is enabled, seam must be explicit about which fields are replaced and which are not.

high.name: No replay of construction decision
high.description: Audit trail must include enough information to reconstruct the construction result from project factory inputs alone.

high.name: No regression test for parity drift
high.description: Phase 9 (TUHO) and Phase 23N (Oborovo) parity snapshots are operating-period only. No construction-period parity snapshot. Wiring engine without one is wiring blind.

high.name: Generic project coverage
high.description: Generic Wind and Generic Solar do not have construction templates. Wiring engine to 'support Generic' without validation is a risk.

medium.name: Asset class allocation at COD
medium.description: Excel assigns IDC to specific asset classes for depreciation. FincoGPT depreciation has no in-service date concept. Depreciation base at COD implicitly 'CAPEX + IDC lumped into one class'.

medium.name: Equity invested vs CAPEX equity
medium.description: Excel has 500 kEUR equity line for TUHO. Runtime treats operating CAPEX equity as 0. Different concepts.

medium.name: Audit trail completeness
medium.description: Diagnostic must include the decision (which field was replaced, which was kept, why) - not just raw numbers.

medium.name: Asset register changes
medium.description: Asset register rebuilt from project factory inputs. If Layer 4 produces asset book values, register must record source.

medium.name: Test data coverage
medium.description: Engine has 2 project templates. Wiring without additional test data risks hardcoding assumptions to these two.

risk_top_5: R-PAR-2: Senior IDC effective rate brittleness (High)
